reading.title: Harbor Walk: new homes on the Old Ferry lot.

candidates.quote: We are considering 10 percent of the 120 homes as workforce homes.
Workforce homes would be for households earning up to 80 percent of area median income.
The length of the income limits is still being discussed, with 15 years as a starting point.
candidates.wording: with 15 years as a starting point
